content:
Amazon's fall Prime Day sale is officially underway, with the best deals ever on AirPods Pro 3 and AirPods Max 2, the M6 Mac mini hitting a new low with up to $150 off, and 2026 Apple Watch discounts also in full swing. Multiple Apple Watch Series 12 configurations have dropped to all-time low prices, and even the brand-new Apple Watch Ultra 4 is seeing nearly $100 in discounts. Keep reading for all the details.

The all-new Apple Watch Series 12 debuts in a new "Dark Brass" colorway alongside a range of new band colors, and Amazon's fall Prime Day sale is currently offering the lowest prices ever.

Right now, you can find various configurations on sale at new low prices with nearly $50 off, including the standard GPS model, the GPS + Cellular version, as well as this 46mm Dark Bronze model paired with the matching "Dark Bronze" Milanese loop band — truly tempting.

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 12 $350 (originally $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 12 $400 (originally $450)
  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 12 GPS + Cellular $450 (originally $500)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 12 GPS + Cellular $500 (originally $550)

Wondering whether you should upgrade to the Apple Watch Series 12? Check out 9to5Mac's in-depth review to help you decide.

Although deals on the all-new Apple Watch Ultra 4 during fall Prime Day have been somewhat inconsistent so far, various configurations keep going in and out of stock, and pricing is at an all-time low — whether it's the standard configuration or the higher-end version paired with the Milanese loop band, both are now seeing nearly $100 in discounts.

As of writing, one standout is the Black Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 4 paired with the latest Burgundy Trail Loop, down $100 to $699.99 with free shipping. But to reiterate, the model paired with the Milanese loop band has also dropped to Prime Day pricing today.

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 4 with Burgundy Trail Loop $700 (originally $799)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 4 with Milanese Loop $800 (originally $899)

Beyond the regular aluminum and titanium Series 12, Apple has also launched a brand-new, exceptionally elegant ceramic edition of the Apple Watch Series 12. Like its counterparts in the traditional luxury watch world, it's positioned at a premium price point, and as Amazon's fall Prime Day event kicks off, we're starting to see the first meaningful discounts.

  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 12 Ceramic GPS + Cellular $900 (originally $949)

Apple didn't release a new entry-level SE model this year, but it's freshened up the experience with new band options, and Prime Big Deal Days is offering the first cash discounts on the following models since launch:

  • Apple Watch SE 3 40mm Midnight $199 (originally $249)
  • Apple Watch SE 3 40mm Starlight $199 (originally $249)
  • Apple Watch SE 3 44mm Midnight $229 (originally $279)
  • Apple Watch SE 3 44mm Starlight $229 (originally $279)
